bullets.title: Flat before NFP
bullets.text: FXEmpire showed gold at 4,066 at 14:07 SAST, flat on the day, while Trading Economics shows about 4,045, down 1% (time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Still in range
bullets.text: Price sits between 4,049-4,057 support and the 4,098 pivot, after Thursday's high of 4,147.

bullets.title: Dollar firmer
bullets.text: The dollar index is about 102.2, up 0.65%, and the US yield shown is about 4.87% (Trading Economics, tenor and time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Hike odds split
bullets.text: December Fed hike odds are 69.1% per FXEmpire and 79-80% per Trading Economics citing CME FedWatch, so treat the exact number as UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Forecast cut
bullets.text: FXEmpire reports Goldman Sachs cut its year-end gold forecast to 4,150 from 4,650, and higher oil is reviving inflation worries.

bullets.title: Jobs report now
bullets.text: A strong jobs number can lift the dollar and push gold toward 4,022 or 4,009, while a weak one can lift it through 4,100.
